description:
How accurate our valuations have been, measured the only way that cannot
    leak: each month, every registered sale the model had ALREADY valued is
    compared with the price actually paid — MdAPE (median absolute
    percentage error), PPE20 (share within 20%) and n, per asset class and
    model version. Until the first vintage lands in October 2026 the answer is
    `status: no_rows_yet` with the metric definitions: an empty table, not a
    zero error. Filters: `asset_class` (Residential | Commercial | Mixed-Use),
    `model_version` (e.g. gbm-h3-v4), `since` (YYYY-MM).
    UK only. Free.
name: valuation_accuracy
title: Our valuation error, forward-validated monthly
